images.description: Nmanduonu, GHANA- August 23, 2022: Portraits of a 90-year-old Fulani woman who migrated and now lives in the town of Nmanduono. The Fula or Fulanis are one of the largest ethnic groups in the Sahel and West Africa and are widely dispersed across the region. They usually travel as Nomads and their ethnic group has the largest nomadic pastoral community in the world.
